text:
Morgan: Quick ping — small threadsafety hotfix PR that should stop the occasional staging p99 spike under concurrency. Can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2764

Morgan: Summary: race in connpool's KV cache invalidation; reproducible under heavy concurrent prefix invalidation. Patch adds a tiny mutex and a short timeout on cache refresh. Tests + basic integ run locally.

DeployBot: CI started for runtime#2764 (linux, unit, integ) :github: 

Olivia: Will review. Can you paste the failing stacktrace you saw (or a short repro) so I can sanity-check the fix path? Also do we have non-regression for cold cache throughput?

Morgan: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-16T22:03:14Z rpc: p99 spike - goroutine 1423: runtime error: concurrent map read and map write
... stack: connpool/cache.go:87 invalidatePrefix -> connpool/refresh.go:41
```
Unit tests cover concurrent access; added small integ that simulates 200 concurrent invalidations — passes locally.

Samir: I'll take a look in ~20m. Do we want to canary this on a small shard first? Might be safer than full rollout.

Jules: quick nit: the timeout you added to refresh() is 250ms — maybe make it configurable or at least 500ms to avoid accidental spurious failures under GC pressure. Also consider exponential backoff for contended invalidations.

Morgan: good call. Pushed a follow-up commit: increased timeout to 500ms and added a basic backoff retry (2x, 100ms). Branch: fix/threadsafe-kv-2764 -> force-pushed.

DeployBot: CI green for runtime#2764 — linux: unit ✓ integ ✓ e2e-skipped (flaky guard). :white_check_mark:

OncallBot: Reminder — merge window for oncall hotfixes is open until 23:00 UTC. Please confirm canary plan when merging.

Samir: LGTM, left an approve on the PR. Suggest canary to 5% traffic for 10 minutes, watch p99 and error-rate for request types A/B. I'm comfortable with merging after canary if metrics stable. :thumbsup:

Morgan: Thanks — merging in 5 and will start canary to 5% for 10m. I'll post metrics (p99 + 5xx) after 10m.

DeployBot: runtime#2764 merged by Morgan. Deploy pipeline started (canary: 5%).

Morgan: Canary started. Will monitor dashboards (p99, 5xx, connpool timeouts). Ping me if you see anything odd.

Samir: Thanks, monitoring now.

Morgan: Canary healthy at +12m: p99 back to baseline, 5xx unchanged. Scaling to 25% then full if stable.

Jules: Nice, great catch.

Morgan: Closing thread, will follow up in release notes.
